# VerifgoodSDK v1.0.1
> GMAO (maintenance management) TypeScript SDK — 53 services
> Generated: 2026-04-13

## Initialization
```typescript
import { VGSDK, Metadatas } from "verifgood-js-sdk";

const sdk = new VGSDK({
  apiBaseUrl: "https://your-api-host.com/public/index.php",
  apiKey: "your-auth0-token"
});
```

## Metadatas (query builder)
Query builder for filtering, pagination, and column selection. Pass to getAll() methods.

Filter actions: equals, not_equals, contains, start_with, end_with, between, is_null, is_not_null, greater_than, less_than, in, not_in

Key methods:
- setFilter(name, value, action?) — add a filter (default action: "equals")
- setLimit(offset, limit) — pagination
- setColumns(columns) — select specific fields
- clearAllFilters() — reset filters
- get() — serialize for API call (used internally)

Response format: { datas: T[], metadatas: { counters: { All: number } } }

Example:
```typescript
const m = new Metadatas();
m.setFilter("status", "active", "equals");
m.setLimit(0, 25);
const result = await sdk.equipements.getAll(m);
```
